clue.text: King had this made specially for crossing river

definitions.note: Martin Luther King's famous speech: 'I have a dream'

indicators.note: the rearranged letters are crossing, i.e. lying across, the river letter, which sits inside them
made specially means these letters are made up again in a new arrangement

parts.note: R is the map abbreviation for river

explanation.surface: A monarch had something purpose-built so he could get across a river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'King' reads as a monarch, but it is Martin Luther King, whose 1963 speech began 'I have a dream'. MADE rearranged gives DEAM, with R placed inside.
explanation.definitionFit: The civil rights leader's most quoted words declare that he has a vision, so this is what he had.

clue.text: Disastrous couple keeping son in poor state

indicators.note: keeping means holding the son letter within the word for disastrous

parts.note: dire means disastrous, dreadful
S is the genealogical abbreviation for son
a pair is a couple

explanation.surface: An unhappy couple are looking after their son despite being badly off.
explanation.definitionFit: A building in disrepair is in bad condition through neglect, a run-down state.

clue.text: Clubs in correct order

indicators.note: in places the clubs letter within the word for correct

parts.note: to edit is to correct a text
C is the card-suit abbreviation for clubs

explanation.surface: A golfer's or card player's clubs are arranged neatly, in the proper sequence.
explanation.definitionFit: An edict is an official decree or command issued by an authority, so a formal order.

clue.text: Like woman raising issue or unusually alert man

indicators.note: unusually signals that the letters of alert and man are arranged in an unusual way

explanation.surface: A description of a woman bringing up a dispute, or else of a man who is surprisingly watchful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Issue' here means offspring, so a woman raising issue is a mother bringing up children.
explanation.definitionFit: Maternal means motherly, characteristic of a mother rearing her offspring.

clue.text: Craft should go round Scottish lake to find border

indicators.note: should go round means the word for craft must surround the Scottish lake

parts.note: guile is craftiness, cunning
a loch is a Scottish lake

explanation.surface: A boat has to sail round a loch to locate the frontier.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Craft' looks like a boat but means cunning.
explanation.definitionFit: A guilloche is an ornamental band of interlaced curves used as a decorative edging in architecture.

clue.text: Bird with raucous call not quite making channel

indicators.note: not quite means the word for channel is cut short, its final letter dropped

parts.note: a gully is a channel worn by water

explanation.surface: A bird whose loud squawk falls a little short of reaching across the Channel.
explanation.definitionFit: Seagulls are known for their harsh screeching cries around coasts and harbours.

clue.text: US violinist sectarians upset

indicators.note: upset signals that the letters of sectarians are knocked over into a new order

explanation.surface: An American musician is annoyed by religious factionalists.
explanation.definitionFit: Isaac Stern was a celebrated American concert violinist of the twentieth century.

clue.text: No calcium needed for spot cream

indicators.note: No means the calcium symbol is absent, taken out of the word for spot

parts.note: a spot is a location, a place
Ca is the chemical symbol for calcium

explanation.surface: A skin cream for pimples that needs no added calcium.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spot' suggests a pimple, which fits the cream, but here it means a place.
explanation.definitionFit: A lotion is a liquid preparation applied to the skin, much like a cream.

clue.text: Labour Party not likely to split?

definitions.text: Labour Party not likely to split?

parts.words: Labour Party not likely to split?
parts.note: a party, or group, of convicts doing hard labour, shackled together so they cannot split up and escape

explanation.walkthrough: The capital L suggests the British political party, prone to splits; read lower-case, it is a work party of prisoners chained together.
explanation.definitionFit: A chain gang is a group of convicts fettered together while doing outdoor labour.

clue.text: Metallica finally exits festival compound

indicators.note: exits means that letter leaves the word for festival

parts.note: Easter is a Christian festival

indicators.note: finally picks out the last letter of Metallica

explanation.surface: The heavy-metal band Metallica leaves a music festival at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: An ester is an organic chemical compound formed from an acid and an alcohol.

clue.text: Small Liverpudlian singer inspiring in tango? Just a little

parts.note: S is the clothing-size abbreviation for small

indicators.note: inspiring means breathing in, so the singer takes the other letters inside her

parts.note: Cilla Black was a singer from Liverpool
T is tango in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A petite Liverpool vocalist motivates people during a tango, only slightly.
explanation.walkthrough: Cilla Black was a 1960s pop singer and TV presenter from Liverpool.
explanation.definitionFit: A scintilla is a tiny trace or spark of something, the smallest amount.

clue.text: Tribute nicely written about saint

indicators.note: about means those words are placed around the saint abbreviation

parts.note: 'to a T' means nicely, exactly right
ST is short for saint; here just S, a common abbreviation

explanation.surface: A neatly penned tribute concerning a holy person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nicely' gives the phrase TO A T, meaning perfectly; 'written' just stresses it is set down around S.
explanation.definitionFit: A toast is a drink raised in honour of someone, a form of salute or homage.

clue.text: Complete religious work in Ireland

indicators.note: in places the religious work within the Irish name for Ireland

parts.note: Eire is the Irish name for Ireland
NT is the New Testament

explanation.surface: A finished religious text produced in Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: Entire and complete are synonyms, both meaning whole, with nothing missing.

clue.text: Check when coming aboard earlier vessel

indicators.note: coming aboard means the check letters board, i.e. go inside, the word for earlier

parts.note: sooner means earlier
CH is the chess abbreviation for check

explanation.surface: An inspection when boarding a ship that arrived previously.
explanation.definitionFit: A schooner is a sailing ship with two or more masts, so a vessel; also a large glass.

clue.text: Elusive Iberian leaders snarled up outside

indicators.note: outside means the phrase for snarled up goes outside the leaders' letters

parts.note: snarled up means in a tangle
the leading two letters of Iberian

explanation.surface: Slippery Spanish and Portuguese leaders get caught up outdoors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Snarled up' gives IN TANGLE, and the first two letters of Iberian go into it.
explanation.definitionFit: Something intangible cannot be touched or grasped, hence hard to pin down.

clue.text: Reactionary TV character bringing stone into converted flat

indicators.note: into means the stone is put inside those rearranged letters
converted means the letters of flat are turned into a different arrangement

parts.note: a garnet is a gemstone

explanation.surface: Someone moving a gem into a flat that has been converted.
explanation.walkthrough: Alf Garnett was the bigoted working-class Londoner in the British sitcom Till Death Us Do Part.
explanation.definitionFit: The sitcom character was a ranting right-wing loudmouth, famously reactionary in his views.

clue.text: Make note about time in cheese-producing region

parts.note: fa is a note in tonic sol-fa

indicators.note: in places the about and time letters inside the cheese region

parts.note: Brie is a region of France that gives its name to a cheese
CA, short for circa, means about

explanation.surface: Write a memo about a period spent in dairy country.
explanation.definitionFit: To fabricate is to construct or manufacture something, and also to invent a lie.

clue.text: Portuguese saint imports good grain for pudding

indicators.note: imports means the saint brings the good letter in

parts.note: São is Portuguese for saint, as in São Paulo

explanation.surface: A holy man from Portugal brings in quality cereal for a dessert.
explanation.definitionFit: Sago is a starch from palm pith formed into small granules and used in milk puddings.

clue.text: New idea put into Bond, leaving book, getting better

indicators.note: put into means the new and idea letters are inserted into what remains
leaving means the book letter departs from the word Bond

parts.note: taken as written
a theme is an idea or subject

explanation.surface: A fresh idea is worked into a James Bond plot, minus the book, and the film improves.
explanation.definitionFit: To be on the mend is an idiom for recovering from illness, improving.

clue.text: Worst thing is to accept twin returning commendations

indicators.note: to accept means the word for the worst thing takes the reversed twin inside

parts.note: 'the pits' is the worst thing

indicators.note: returning means the word for twin is read backwards

parts.note: dual means twin, double

explanation.surface: The worst thing is having to welcome back a sibling's praise.
explanation.definitionFit: Plaudits are expressions of praise or approval, like applause.

clue.text: Sort of red polish unknown

parts.note: to rub is to polish
Y is a mathematical unknown

explanation.surface: A mystery type of red nail varnish.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruby is a deep crimson shade named after the gemstone.

clue.text: Nonchalant during escape, one ought to be strung up

definitions.text: one ought to be strung up

indicators.note: during means the nonchalant word sits within the escape word

parts.note: flight is escape, fleeing
airy means nonchalant, casual

explanation.surface: A fugitive who is casual while escaping deserves to be hanged.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Strung up' suggests hanging a criminal, but it is decorations hung on a string.
explanation.definitionFit: Fairy lights are small decorative bulbs on a cable, hung at Christmas.

clue.text: Burning a jacket king's taken off

indicators.note: taken off means the king's letter is removed from the jacket

parts.note: a blazer is a jacket
R, for Rex, is the abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A jacket the monarch has removed.
explanation.definitionFit: Ablaze means on fire, alight.

clue.text: Game in which Josh Billings initially behind bars?

indicators.note: behind bars means held within the cage, so the inner letters sit inside it

parts.note: a cage is made of bars
to josh is to tease, to rib

indicators.note: initially picks out the first letter of Billings

explanation.surface: A card game in which someone called Josh Billings first ended up in prison.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Josh Billings' looks like a name but splits into a verb and a word giving its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Cribbage is a card game scored by moving pegs on a board.

clue.text: Problem breathing arises where coating on pills removed

indicators.note: removed means those outer letters are taken out of the phrase for arises

parts.note: crops up means arises

indicators.note: the coating on pills is their outside, the first and last letters

explanation.surface: A breathing difficulty appears when the coating on tablets has been stripped off.
explanation.definitionFit: Croup is a childhood respiratory illness with a barking cough and laboured breathing.

clue.text: Understated, it should be expunged from screen translation

indicators.note: should be expunged from means the word it is struck out of the screen translation

parts.note: a subtitle is a translation shown on screen

explanation.surface: A film translator is told that a word must be removed from the caption.
explanation.definitionFit: Subtle means delicate and restrained rather than obvious.

clue.text: One article written about another Macbeth for example

indicators.note: written about means the first article is set down around the second

parts.note: the is the definite article
an is another article, the indefinite one

explanation.surface: An essay about another person, such as Macbeth.
explanation.definitionFit: Macbeth was Thane of Glamis and of Cawdor, a Scottish noble title.

clue.text: Artist having lamb to start with after nil by mouth

indicators.note: after means the artist comes after the nil letter

parts.note: O is nil, zero
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

indicators.note: to start with picks out the first letter of lamb

explanation.surface: A painter has lamb as a starter after fasting, nothing by mouth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nil by mouth' is a hospital instruction, but 'nil' is O and 'by mouth' the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Oral means taken or given through the mouth, as with medicine.

clue.text: Spiritual icon I see at last in Nebraskan city

indicators.note: at last means the exclamation comes at the end

parts.note: om is the sacred syllable and symbol in Hinduism and Buddhism
aha is an exclamation meaning I see, I understand

explanation.surface: A religious symbol I finally spot in a Midwestern city.
explanation.definitionFit: Omaha is the largest city in the US state of Nebraska.

clue.text: Act to defend author penning nasty piece of work

indicators.note: penning means enclosing, so the author holds the cad inside

parts.note: J. M. Barrie was the author of Peter Pan
a cad is a dishonourable man

explanation.surface: A writer creating a villain in a defensive play.
explanation.definitionFit: To barricade is to block a place off to protect it against attack.

clue.text: Reported truce spread by degrees

indicators.note: reported means said aloud, so the word for truce gives a word that sounds the same

parts.note: peace is a truce
a spread is a lavish meal

explanation.surface: News of an armistice spreads gradually.
explanation.definitionFit: Piecemeal means done bit by bit, gradually rather than all at once.

clue.text: Horse cooked in casserole wife chucked out

indicators.note: chucked out means the wife letter is thrown out of the word

parts.note: stewed means cooked slowly in a casserole

explanation.surface: A horse stewed in a casserole, and the wife got rid of it.
explanation.definitionFit: A steed is a horse, especially one for riding, in literary use.
